label: Brownfield land registers
one_row_is: one site on a local planning authority's brownfield land register, as last published

columns.name: body
columns.meaning: the local planning authority that keeps the register, as the index names the publisher

columns.name: site_reference
columns.meaning: the authority's own reference for the site (SiteReference in the 2017 standard)

columns.name: site_name_address
columns.meaning: the site's name and address as published (SiteNameAddress)

columns.name: hectares
columns.meaning: site area in hectares as published

columns.name: ownership_status
columns.meaning: 'owned by a public authority', 'not owned by a public authority', 'mixed ownership' or 'unknown ownership', as published

columns.name: permission_type
columns.meaning: full planning permission, outline, reserved matters, permission in principle, etc., as published

columns.name: permission_date
columns.meaning: date of the most recent permission, as published

columns.name: min_net_dwellings
columns.meaning: minimum net dwellings the authority estimates the site could support (MinNetDwellings)

columns.name: max_net_dwellings
columns.meaning: upper end of the authority's range (NetDwellingsRangeTo), where given

columns.name: deliverable
columns.meaning: whether the authority considers the site deliverable within five years, as published

columns.name: hazardous_substances
columns.meaning: whether hazardous-substances consent applies, as published

columns.name: site_plan_url
columns.meaning: link to the authority's site plan, as published

columns.name: first_added_date
columns.meaning: date the site first entered the register

columns.name: last_updated_date
columns.meaning: date the entry was last updated

columns.name: lon
columns.meaning: longitude (WGS84): given by the file, or converted from its eastings/northings

columns.name: notes
columns.meaning: the authority's notes or development description, as published

rules: A register is a snapshot: the family takes each authority's register as last published, one row per site, never merging years.
Columns follow the 2017 Brownfield Land Register data standard (Part 1 and Part 2 of the register); a file that uses its own headings is mapped to them by a person.
Hectares and dwelling estimates are the authority's own figures, kept as published; nothing is recomputed.
A site's coordinates are taken as the file states its coordinate reference system: British National Grid eastings/northings converted, WGS84 kept.
Where an authority publishes several years' registers as separate datasets, the newest is the family's source; older ones stay findable in the index.
